name: SnappyMail
description: Fast, light webmail for your existing email accounts

paths.name: Snappymail
paths.description: SnappyMail's settings, domains, contacts, plugins and the admin password (_data_/_default_/admin_password.txt). Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: SnappyMail webmail and admin panel, published on host as 6786

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: UPLOAD_MAX_SIZE
variables.description: The biggest attachment you can send, like 25M.

variables.name: SECURE_COOKIES
variables.description: Set to true once you only open SnappyMail over https (through a reverse proxy). Over plain http it must stay false, or you can't sign in.
